assumptions.bbn_grid: 401 logarithmic points in 1e8 <= z <= 1e10, spanning the requested BBN comparison bracket
assumptions.geometry: flat FLRW; same present-day Omega_b, Omega_c, Omega_v closure, photons and neutrinos in IVS and Lambda
assumptions.neutrinos: all neutrinos treated as massless radiation at all redshifts
assumptions.temperature_redshift_note: Redshift comparison is direct; converting T_CMB to photon temperature at high z would require e+e- entropy-transfer corrections, not modeled here.

classification: independent bounded homogeneous-background comparison; no abundance computation

numerics.solver: SciPy DOP853, float64, one CPU thread, dense output

source_point.sign_interpretation: Gamma<0 makes rho_v decrease forward/increase backward; backward comoving CDM q_c=a^3*rho_c decreases from its present value

units_and_normalization.H0: km s^-1 Mpc^-1; cancels in H_IVS/H_Lambda
units_and_normalization.density_variables: dimensionless fractions normalized to the same present critical density within each case
